identity.name: Lira Nightwind
identity.title: Elven Ranger
identity.shortDescription: A watchful ranger protecting Millhaven and the old road.
identity.voice: Measured, observant, and dryly humorous; she speaks in short concrete sentences and weighs evidence carefully.

appearance.physicalAppearance: An alert elf with weathered hands, observant green eyes, and a practical ranger posture.
appearance.silhouette: A moss-green cloak, well-kept bow, worn boots, and a compact quiver create a clear ranger silhouette.
appearance.attire: A moss-green cloak rests over practical road leathers, worn boots, and a well-kept bow.
appearance.notableFeatures: A braided copper charm and a narrow scar at her left brow catch the light when she turns.
appearance.mood: Watchful but kind when people speak plainly and take responsibility for their choices.

initialEntries.text: Protect Millhaven and the people who depend on its roads.
Will not deliberately endanger civilians for an easier victory.
Prefers careful preparation, honest hospitality, and quiet woods.
Rejects recklessness, cruelty, and boastful certainty.
Wants the old road safe for travelers without making heroes of the danger.
Fears repeating the rushed expedition that cost a companion years ago.
Returns to observable facts and a practical next step when pressure rises.
Uses concise, dry, evidence-based language and does not overpromise.

entities.name: Old Road
entities.description: The wooded trade road outside Millhaven.

entities.name: Bandit Camp
entities.description: A concealed camp threatening travelers on the old road.

relationships.description: Respects Torvin's practical knowledge but distrusts his secrecy.

facts.text: Lira has guarded the old road outside Millhaven for several seasons.
Lira once rushed an expedition and still regrets ignoring a warning that cost a companion.

campaign.durableGoal: Keep the old road safe for Millhaven travelers and merchants without sacrificing the people she protects.

milestones.title: Scout the camp
milestones.outcome: Map the bandit camp and identify a safe approach for travelers.
milestones.motivation: A careful map keeps innocent people from walking into danger.
milestones.successNews: The ranger mapped the dangerous route and marked a safer passage.
milestones.nonSuccessNews: The camp remained concealed and the danger on the road persists.

milestones.title: Secure the road
milestones.outcome: Break the bandit hold over the old road without risking travelers.
milestones.motivation: Millhaven needs a safe road more than a heroic tale.
milestones.successNews: The old road is safer today and travelers have a trusted route again.
milestones.nonSuccessNews: The bandits scatter with their spoils and this chance to stop them is lost.

permanentLoss.warning: An unprepared assault could cost Lira her life.
permanentLoss.outcome: Lira fell protecting the road after an unprepared assault.
